headline: Exchange Intake Rises To 1,133.6 Million Dollars From 766.8 Million
narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 venues rose to 1,133.6 million dollars, 0.4169 percent of the 271.9 billion dollars held there excluding each venue's own token, from 766.8 million dollars and 0.2817 percent in the prior reading. Binance took in 554.1 million dollars and Bitget took in 403.2 million dollars, while Bitstamp posted a 43.7 million dollar outflow and Crypto.com posted a 39.2 million dollar outflow. The pipe measures the change in dollars held on the venues excluding each exchange's own token, so the larger positive total means more money arrived than in the prior reading, with Binance and Bitget the largest arrivals.
author: jordan
